intro.title: What rent for your property?
intro.text: Four short steps, then a realistic rent range based on public data. Free and without obligation: to see the result, you leave your contact details at the end.

result.subtitle: {type} in {commune}

appartement.high: Many known rents for this type of home in your area.
appartement.medium: Solid data, but less of it here.
appartement.low: Little data for this property: treat with caution.

maison.medium: Based on house listings in your area.
maison.low: Few comparable houses for rent: treat with caution.

result.disclaimer: Indicative estimate based on public statistics. It does not replace a visit.
result.legalText: Rent may not exceed a legal cap linked to the capital invested: 5% per year. I will check this with you.
result.legalMeuble: Furnished: furniture is charged separately, at most 1.5% per month of the furniture’s value (invoices under 10 years old). It is not included in this rent.
result.compareNote: The calculation starts from rents in the canton of {deCanton}, then adapts to your living area.
result.compareNoteMaison: The calculation starts from house listings in your area, then adapts to your living area.
result.factorsNone: Your property matches the average: no adjustment.
result.factorsCapped: To stay cautious, the total adjustment is capped.
result.howAppartement: Starting point: rents actually paid in the canton of {deCanton}, from the Observatoire de l’Habitat survey, for a home of your size. They are updated with the official rent trend, then adjusted for condition, energy class, floor, outdoor space and parking.
result.howMaison: There are no detailed public rents for houses. The calculation starts from house listings collected in your area ({zone}), for a house of your size, then adjusts for condition and energy class.
result.howRange: The bottom of the range matches recently signed leases, the top matches rents asked in today’s listings. Furnished rooms and flat-shares are not counted.
result.sourceAppartement: Sources: Observatoire de l’Habitat, “cadastre des loyers” survey (2025) and advertised rent index ({trimestre}); listings collected on {date}.
result.sourceMaison: Sources: house listings collected on {date}; Observatoire de l’Habitat, advertised rent index ({trimestre}).
result.next1: I receive your request and get back to you.
result.next2: Together we check the rent on site, the legal cap and what I can take care of for you.
result.factorsMaisonInclus: For a house, the garden, garage and number of bedrooms are already included in the comparison value.
result.factorsNoneMaison: Condition and energy class match the average: no adjustment.
result.copie: A copy of your result has been sent to {email}. Nothing received? Check your spam folder.
result.lowTextMaison: Estimated level of signed leases (assumption: about 15% below listings)
result.howRangeMaison: For houses, the top of the range comes from house listings; the bottom is an estimate (assumption: leases are signed about 15% below asking rents, as for apartments). Furnished rooms and flat-shares are not counted.
result.ecart: Depending on the actual condition, exact location and features, the rent achieved may differ by 15 to 20%.
